player_action: Come on, I rolled a natural 20 on initiative, so I should get two turns in the first round. That's how crits work.
correct_ruling: No. A natural 20 on an initiative check has no special effect; initiative is a Dexterity check and you simply use the total. One turn per round.
srd_reference: CombatI.rtf > Initiative; Skills/Ability checks (no auto success on natural 20 for checks)

player_action: I draw my sword as I move up to the orc and attack.
game_state: Fighter BAB +2, sword sheathed, no Quick Draw. Orc 25 ft away.
correct_ruling: Drawing a weapon is a move action, but if you have BAB +1 or higher you can combine it with a regular move. So the fighter can move, draw (as part of the move), and attack with his standard action.
srd_reference: CombatII.rtf > Move Actions > Draw or Sheathe a Weapon
common_wrong_rulings: Drawing is a free action for everyone.

player_action: I ready an action to attack the orc when it attacks me, and I want it to happen first so it might die before it swings.
game_state: Fighter adjacent to orc; readied a melee attack with trigger 'when the orc attacks me'.
correct_ruling: Legal. The readied attack occurs immediately before the triggering action; if the orc is killed, its attack doesn't happen. The fighter's initiative then moves to just before the orc.
common_wrong_rulings: Readied attacks happen after the trigger resolves.

player_action: I readied a spell but the trigger never happened. Next turn I want to keep it readied and also take my full turn.
game_state: Wizard readied a spell; trigger did not occur before his next turn.
correct_ruling: If the readied action isn't triggered before your next turn, you don't get to take it; you can ready the same action again on your new turn, but that uses your actions for that turn. There's no carrying it over on top of a full turn.
common_wrong_rulings: Readied action persists indefinitely while acting normally.

player_action: I cast a spell with a 1 round casting time, like summon monster. When does it go off?
game_state: Cleric casting summon monster I (casting time 1 round).
correct_ruling: A 1-round casting time is a full-round action and the spell takes effect just before the start of the caster's next turn. The caster must maintain concentration until then.
srd_reference: MagicOverview.rtf > Casting Time; SpellsS.rtf > Summon Monster I
common_wrong_rulings: Takes effect at end of next turn.

player_action: I stand from prone and attack.
correct_ruling: Standing is a move action (provokes an AoO), then the fighter can take a standard action to attack once. No full attack.

player_action: I join combat late after being in the next room. What initiative do I use?
game_state: Combat has gone 3 rounds; a new character enters.
correct_ruling: Characters entering a battle later roll initiative when they join and are inserted into the order at that count.

player_action: The ambushers are hiding in the trees; do I get to act in the surprise round?
game_state: Party walking; bandits hidden. Rogue made a Spot check vs bandits' Hide; fighter failed.
correct_ruling: The DM determines who is aware at the start of battle (via Listen/Spot checks or other means). Aware characters act in the surprise round; the rogue does, the fighter doesn't and is flat-footed.
common_wrong_rulings: Whole party surprised or none, as a group.

player_action: I start the full-round spell and someone hits me. Can I finish casting?
game_state: Wizard casting a 1-round spell; hit by an arrow for 8 damage before it takes effect.
correct_ruling: Damaged while casting requires a Concentration check (DC 10 + damage dealt + spell level). Failure loses the spell.
common_wrong_rulings: No check needed until it's complete.

player_action: I use Action Surge to take another standard action.
correct_ruling: Action Surge is not a D&D 3.5 SRD rule; 3.5 fighters get bonus feats, not extra actions. The player gets the normal standard plus move (or one full-round action).

player_action: I attack 4 times with my BAB +16 even though I moved 10 feet.
game_state: Fighter BAB +16, moved 10 ft this round.
correct_ruling: A full attack requires a full-round action; you can't move more than a 5-foot step. Having moved 10 ft, the fighter gets only a single attack (standard action).

player_action: How many attacks does my BAB +11 fighter get on a full attack?
correct_ruling: Three attacks at +11, +6, and +1 (iterative attacks every 5 points of BAB).
srd_reference: CombatI.rtf > Attack Bonus; CombatII.rtf > Full Attack

player_action: I'm stunned. Can I at least take a 5-foot step?
correct_ruling: A stunned creature can't take actions (and drops what it holds, loses Dex to AC, attackers +2). No 5-foot step.

player_action: I'm staggered. I want to move and attack.
game_state: Fighter has taken nonlethal damage exactly equal to his current hit points (staggered).
correct_ruling: A staggered creature can take only a single move action or standard action each round (not both, and no full-round actions).

player_action: I know I'm at 0 hit points and disabled, but I really need to cast cure light wounds on myself — it's a heal, it shouldn't hurt me.
correct_ruling: Disabled characters can take only a single move or standard action each round. Taking a standard action (like casting) deals 1 hp of damage after the action unless it increases hit points — casting cure on yourself works, and since it heals, the cleric ends up with positive hp. So yes, the cast is allowed; the strenuous-action damage only matters if the action doesn't heal.
srd_reference: CombatI.rtf > Injury and Death > Disabled (0 Hit Points)
common_wrong_rulings: Cleric drops to -1 regardless of healing.
confidence_note: SRD text: strenuous action deals 1 damage 'unless the action increased the disabled character's hit points'; exact phrasing not re-checked.

player_action: I cast a touch spell, then move to my ally and deliver it the same round.
game_state: Cleric with a touch spell (casting time 1 standard action). Ally 20 ft away.
correct_ruling: Legal. You can cast a touch spell and, as part of that casting, touch a target (free action); or move after casting and touch the ally as a free action in the same round. Holding the charge is allowed.

player_action: I want to ready an action to shove my ally out of the way if the dragon breathes.
game_state: Fighter adjacent to wizard ally; dragon may breathe.
correct_ruling: Readying a standard action with that trigger is legal; it resolves before the breath. The SRD doesn't have a 'shove an ally' action — a bull rush on a willing ally or similar is a DM adjudication of how the move works (willing creature, check needed or not).
common_wrong_rulings: Automatically saves the ally from all damage.
confidence_note: Whether a bull rush on a willing ally needs a roll is not stated in the SRD.

player_action: I drop my bow and draw my sword in the same round, then attack.
game_state: Ranger BAB +5, bow in hand, sword sheathed, enemy adjacent.
correct_ruling: Dropping an item is a free action; drawing the sword is a move action; then a standard attack. Legal, though only one attack (no full attack).
srd_reference: CombatII.rtf > Free Actions > Drop an Item; Move Actions > Draw a Weapon
